title: Automate KMS + TLS cert rotation for private-installer (Vault + sealed-secrets)
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require automated, auditable rotation of TLS certificates and KMS keys (customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations) to meet compliance and reduce operational toil. This PR adds automation hooks to the private-installer Helm charts and Terraform modules to (1) integrate with Vault for dynamic key/cert issuance, (2) support sealed-secrets-based encrypted secrets in cluster manifests, and (3) provide upgrade/rollback-aware rotation jobs and operator-managed reconciliation.

What this change does: Adds a new terraform/iam/kms module to configure external KMS bindings (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/On-prem HSM connector), vault-init and vault-role helm templates in private-installer, a sealed-secrets bootstrap job and a cert-rotation controller Job template, and upgrade hooks to ensure rotations are run safely during chart upgrades. Also updates the private-installer README and upgrade docs with step-by-step migration and rollback guidance.

Highlights: - Terraform module: optional kms_key bindings, KMS policy templates, and outputs for vault auto-unseal configuration. - Helm: vault-init sidecar templates; sealed-secrets bootstrap job (creates sealed secret keypairs on first install or upgrade if absent); cert-rotation controller (Kubernetes CronJob) that requests short-lived TLS certs from Vault and updates Secrets using sealed-secrets for encryption. - Upgrade/rollback: pre-upgrade hook verifies vault role permissions, post-upgrade hook runs a dry-run rotation and creates a reconcilation checkpoint; rollback hook restores previous sealed secret objects from a sealed-secrets snapshot stored in the chart's backup Secret. - Security: all secrets written to cluster are sealed with SealedSecrets public key; KMS keys never stored plaintext in cluster; Vault tokens are retrieved via configured auth methods (Kubernetes auth or approle) and rotated via TTLs.

Testing and validation: includes unit-level Helm template tests, Terraform plan snapshots, and an integration test harness (perf-canary based mini-cluster) that validates rotation lifecycle and a simulated Vault auto-unseal. CI added checks for helm lint, terraform fmt/validate/plan, and e2e rotation smoke.

Related work: ENG-3782, SEC-91. Linear/Ticket refs are included in commits and release notes.

Notes for reviewers: Focus review on Helm hooks (pre/post/rollback), the sealed-secrets bootstrap safety checks (idempotency), and Terraform outputs for vault auto-unseal. There is a migration path documented in the README; if an operator chooses not to enable Vault, behavior falls back to existing static secrets flow.

release_notes:
- Added optional Terraform KMS module to bind external KMS/HSM for private deployments.
- Helm: automated sealed-secrets bootstrap and cert-rotation CronJob that requests short-lived TLS certs from Vault.
- Migration: documented upgrade and rollback steps; safe defaults keep existing static secrets if Vault is not enabled.
- Security: sealed-secrets ensures cluster secrets remain encrypted; Vault integration avoids storing KMS material in cluster.
security_impact: This PR introduces Vault-based dynamic cert/key issuance. Operators must configure Vault auth and KMS bindings. When enabled, this reduces long-lived secret exposure; operators should validate Vault ACLs and HSM integrations.
notes: Follow-up work: housekeeping PR to rename some templates per naming convention, add HSM connector docs for on-prem appliances, and add additional e2e scenarios for multi-region private clusters.
